Hi Samira — thanks for confirming and congrats again on the case study visibility. Short answers below and next steps.

- Typical package: we offer a $150 e-gift card + a compact "care kit" (branded notebook, travel charger, and a reusable water bottle). Combined option is most common for advocates.
- Donation receipt: Redwood can provide a donation confirmation for the matched gift (we work with our finance team to issue a PDF receipt that includes company name and tax ID). Rachel on finance will produce that.

Next steps I’ll kick off today:
1) Send the kit order to our fulfillment partner ShipFast (I’ll include tracking once it ships).
2) Rachel will send the donation receipt PDF to you after processing.

If you prefer a different dollar amount or only a gift card, tell me and I’ll adjust. Otherwise I’ll proceed with $150 e-gift + kit to the corporate address you shared.
